title: Service request procedure for UE attached for access to RLOS not accepted by the network

entities.name: Service request procedure for UE attached for access to RLOS not accepted
entities.description: Procedure executed when service request for UE attached for access to RLOS cannot be accepted by the network. Specifies UE behavior including local detach and PLMN selection.

entities.name: UE in same selected PLMN where last service request was attempted and rejected
entities.description: Condition where UE remains in the same PLMN where previous service request was rejected.

entities.name: Service request rejected with EMM cause value other than #9, #10, #40
entities.description: Condition where service request rejection uses specific EMM cause values excluding #9, #10, and #40.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that must not be running for certain service request rejection procedures.

entities.name: Local detach
entities.description: UE performs local detach if not already detached, followed by PLMN selection for EPS attach via another PLMN.

entities.name: PLMN selection for EPS attach via another PLMN
entities.description: UE performs PLMN selection according to 3GPP TS 23.122 to attempt EPS attach for access to RLOS via another PLMN.

entities.name: Service request procedure for abnormal cases
entities.description: Procedure executed when service request fails due to abnormal cases a), b), c) or e) in clause 5.6.1.6.

relations.description: Service request rejection procedure requires UE to be in same PLMN where last service request was rejected.
Service request rejection procedure requires specific EMM cause values for rejection.
Service request rejection procedure is guarded by timer T3346 not running.
Service request rejection procedure includes local detach as a step.
Service request rejection procedure includes PLMN selection for EPS attach via another PLMN.
Service request abnormal procedure includes local detach as a step when in same PLMN.
Service request abnormal procedure includes PLMN selection for EPS attach via another PLMN.
